Create exactly ONE new full native-resolution 1254x1254 or larger square transparent RGBA run-animation frame E05 for the SAME celestial musician girl, a new independent painted joint pose.
REFERENCE ORDER: Image 1 is the already painted E01 RUN frame and is the strict anchor for identity, exact head and body size, hair and outfit design, side-profile camera, lighting, outline treatment and canvas framing. Image 2 is original E-direction identity; image 3 is higher-resolution same character detail; image 4 is approved PRIMARY painted art-style reference, no UI or text to copy.
Keep exactly the anchored girl: plum purple straight long hair, lotus bun and pearl-gold headpiece, violet eyes/forehead jewel, ivory lavender warm-gold sleeves/tunic, purple pants, matching ankle boots, green knot and purple tassel. Preserve the elongated purple/gold crescent-decorated qin, all proportions and number of limbs.
DIRECTION EAST screen-right, orthographic slight elevated game camera, face fully facing right, no camera rotation. Fixed canvas, common virtual floor y=93.5%; never auto-center by silhouette or move feet back to ground in flight. Keep identical character scale and upper-body spatial placement; only natural 16-frame run motion. Hair/sleeves trail left with restrained secondary movement.
SPECIFIC POSE E05 / 16, 30ms per frame: RIGHT foot has just pushed off and is trailing behind screen-left, knee folding and heel lifting toward buttock. FAR LEFT thigh is swinging forward screen-right with knee bent about 75 degrees. BOTH feet visibly airborne, the lowest sole 6% canvas above virtual ground. Body/head/shoulders about 2% canvas higher than contact E01; same size, no camera zoom. Qin cradled 2% higher and slightly rearward relative to hip as shoulders counter-rotate against advancing left leg. This is a modest forward run, not a vertical jump.
This is a real two-step running cycle. Both shoulders and elbows coordinate with the legs while carrying a large instrument. Anatomical LEFT hand firmly supports forward/high qin end, RIGHT near hand securely supports lower/near body of qin, never swapping or releasing hands, never a playing/plucking gesture. Allow small coherent whole-qin tilt, no bending instrument. No copying/mirroring/warping the prior frame. No motion blur, ground/shadow, backgrounds, labels, grid, other views, extra limbs, ghost traces, crop or magenta fringe. Actual transparency around a single complete character. Return one frame only.
